# Acumo

> Acumo is a technical engineering agency building AI-native web products for growth-stage businesses and enterprises — including low-latency Voice AI agents, custom AI chatbots, full-stack SaaS MVPs, and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO). Acumo specializes in Next.js architecture, real-time voice pipelines, and technical schema optimization for AI search platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity.

Acumo designs and ships production-grade AI systems rather than templated websites or off-the-shelf widgets. Engagements typically start with a scoped technical proposal and move directly into custom engineering.

## Services

- [Voice AI & CRM Systems](https://www.acumoai.com/services/voice-ai-crm): Custom voice agents engineered for inbound/outbound calls with real-time lead qualification, 24/7 calendar booking, and CRM integration (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce).
- [Full-Stack MVP Build](https://www.acumoai.com/services/mvp-development): Rapid 0-to-1 web/mobile application builds with scalable backends, modern tech stacks (Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL), and AI integrations.
- [Websites & Booking Engine](https://www.acumoai.com/services/websites-booking): Ultra-fast custom websites with embedded scheduling, payment gateways, and automated client portals built for conversion.
- [Custom AI & Automations](https://www.acumoai.com/services/ai-automation): Custom LLM pipelines, RAG implementations, WhatsApp/SMS bots, and automated business operations.

- [How We Turned a Spreadsheet Into a Conversational AI Reporting System](https://www.acumoai.com/articles/ai-spreadsheet-automation-conversational-reporting-system): A real-world look at using the OpenAI API to turn natural language into spreadsheet updates, generate charts, and automate monthly PDF reports.
- [How Rental Businesses Can Get Recommended by ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity](https://www.acumoai.com/articles/how-rental-businesses-can-get-recommended-by-chatgpt-claude-and-perplexity-for-local-inquiries): Answer engine optimization (AEO) strategies that make rental companies discoverable and recommendable in AI search.
- [The Death of the 'Request a Quote' Form](https://www.acumoai.com/articles/the-death-of-the-request-a-quote-form-how-ai-powered-instant-estimators-3x-event-rental-bookings): How AI-powered instant estimators replace slow quote forms and 3x event rental bookings.
- [Why Event Rental Companies Lose 35% of Revenue to Missed Calls](https://www.acumoai.com/articles/why-event-rental-companies-lose-35percent-of-revenue-to-missed-calls): How voice AI recovers revenue lost to missed calls and books rental events automatically, 24/7.
- [Your Business Has the Information. Why Are Your Employees Still Entering It?](https://www.acumoai.com/articles/your-business-has-the-information-why-are-your-employees-still-entering-it): How AI turns unstructured documents, emails, and requests into automated business actions.
- [Open-Weight AI Models vs Proprietary LLMs](https://www.acumoai.com/articles/open-weight-ai-models-vs-proprietary-llms-how-to-get-better-ai-development-economics-in-2026): How to get better AI development economics, performance, and control in 2026.
- [What Happens When Your Business Doesn't Reply Fast Enough?](https://www.acumoai.com/articles/what-happens-when-your-business-doesnt-reply-fast-enough): How AI WhatsApp Assistants capture instant leads for appointment-based service businesses.
- [Voice AI Latency & Infrastructure Region Fix](https://www.acumoai.com/articles/your-voice-ai-isnt-slow-because-of-the-model-its-slow-because-of-where-you-deployed-it): Technical analysis of reducing voice agent response delays by aligning deployment regions.
- [Demystifying Voice AI Architecture](https://www.acumoai.com/articles/i-thought-voice-ai-was-just-stt-llm-tts-i-was-wrong): Breaking down speech-to-text, LLM inference, and text-to-speech orchestration.
- [Why Manual Appointment Booking Is Slowing Your Business Down](https://www.acumoai.com/articles/why-manual-appointment-booking-is-slowing-your-business-down): Automating booking flows to maximize lead conversion rates.

## Case Studies

- [Chart Visualizer](https://www.acumoai.com/#case-studies): Agentic natural language data analysis platform converting conversational prompts into charts. Stack: Python, FastAPI, React, Docker, GPT-4o.
- [Policy Viz](https://www.acumoai.com/#case-studies): Grounded policy retrieval system with zero hallucinations. Stack: LangChain, Pinecone, Next.js, TypeScript.
- [Andent Suite](https://www.acumoai.com/#case-studies): Practice management portal for dental clinics with real-time multi-location sync. Stack: React, GraphQL, Node.js, PostgreSQL.
